Package data

Class JdbcDataStore

java.lang.Object
data.JdbcDataStore
All Implemented Interfaces:
DataStore
public class JdbcDataStore extends Object implements DataStore
DataStore backed by squad_21_db. Each call opens its own connection and closes it when done. Every method runs real SQL; MockDataStore is only used when there is no db.properties.

  • Field Details

    • database

      private final Database database
      Connection settings; every call opens a fresh connection from it.

    • INVENTORY_SELECT

      private static final String INVENTORY_SELECT
      Base query for inventory rows. inventory_item has one row per ingredient per drink (Tapioca Pearls shows up once for every drink that uses it), so each row is shown with the drink it is stocked for. on_order is true while the row has a pending restock order.
      See Also:

    • useStockForOrder

      private static void useStockForOrder(Connection c, int orderId) throws SQLException
      Lowers inventory_item.stock for every ingredient row of the drinks in one order. Each line uses quantity * servings_used, rounded up to a whole unit because stock is an integer (4 drinks at 0.25 bag = 1 bag). Stock never goes below 0. Runs on the caller's connection so it commits or rolls back together with the sale.
      Parameters:
      c - the connection the sale is being saved on
      orderId - the order whose lines were just inserted
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the update fails

    • getInventoryUsage

      public List<InventoryUsage> getInventoryUsage(LocalDate from, LocalDate to)
      Description copied from interface: DataStore
      How much of each inventory item sales used, for the Inventory Usage report. Refunded sales count too: the drink was already made, so its ingredients and supplies are gone either way. Usage for an inventory row is quantity sold times servings_used; rows for the same item (same name, category and unit) are added together.
      Specified by:
      getInventoryUsage in interface DataStore
      Parameters:
      from - the first day, inclusive
      to - the last day, inclusive
      Returns:
      one row per inventory item, most used first
